csharpCode: using UnityEngine; using Unity.Netcode; public class InspectPlayer { public static string Run() { NetworkManager nm = Object.FindObjectOfType<NetworkManager>(true); if (nm == null || nm.NetworkConfig.PlayerPrefab == null) return "No PlayerPrefab"; GameObject prefab = nm.NetworkConfig.PlayerPrefab; string res = "Components: "; foreach (var comp in prefab.GetComponents<Component>()) { res += comp.GetType().Name + ", "; } return res; } }
